entries.title: Job 37:1
segments: Yea, at this my heart trembleth, And is moved out of its place.

entries.title: Job 37:2
segments: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, And the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

entries.title: Job 37:3
segments: He sendeth it forth under the whole heaven, And his lightening unto the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Job 37:4
segments: After it a voice roareth; He thundereth with the voice of his majesty; And he restraineth not [the lightnings] when his voice is heard.

entries.title: Job 37:5
segments: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; Great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

entries.title: Job 37:6
segments: For he saith to the snow, Fall thou on the earth; Likewise to the shower of rain, And to the showers of his mighty rain.

entries.title: Job 37:7
segments: He sealeth up the hand of every man, That all men whom he hath made may know [it].

entries.title: Job 37:8
segments: Then the beasts go into coverts, And remain in their dens.

entries.title: Job 37:9
segments: Out of the chamber [of the south] cometh the storm, And cold out of the north.

entries.title: Job 37:10
segments: By the breath of God ice is given; And the breadth of the waters is straitened.

entries.title: Job 37:11
segments: Yea, he ladeth the thick cloud with moisture; He spreadeth abroad the cloud of his lightning:

entries.title: Job 37:12
segments: And it is turned round about by his guidance, That they may do whatsoever he commandeth them Upon the face of the habitable world,

entries.title: Job 37:13
segments: Whether it be for correction, or for his land, Or for lovingkindness, that he cause it to come.

entries.title: Job 37:14
segments: Hearken unto this, O Job: Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

entries.title: Job 37:15
segments: Dost thou know how God layeth [his charge] upon them, And causeth the lightning of his cloud to shine?

entries.title: Job 37:16
segments: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, The wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

entries.title: Job 37:17
segments: How thy garments are warm, When the earth is still by reason of the south [wind]?

entries.title: Job 37:18
segments: Canst thou with him spread out the sky, Which is strong as a molten mirror?

entries.title: Job 37:19
segments: Teach us what we shall say unto him; [For] we cannot set [our speech] in order by reason of darkness.

entries.title: Job 37:20
segments: Shall it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

entries.title: Job 37:21
segments: And now men see not the light which is bright in the skies; But the wind passeth, and cleareth them.

entries.title: Job 37:22
segments: Out of the north cometh golden splendor: God hath upon him terrible majesty.

entries.title: Job 37:23
segments: [Touching] the Almighty, we cannot find him out  He is excellent in power; And in justice and plenteous righteousness he will not afflict.

entries.title: Job 37:24
segments: Men do therefore fear him: He regardeth not any that are wise of heart.
